title: IBM MQ 9.4.0.0 to 9.4.0.26, 9.4.1.0 to 9.4.5.3, and 10.0.0.1 to 10.0.0.5 could allow an authenticated attacker to…
description: IBM MQ versions 9.4.0.0 through 9.4.0.26, 9.4.1.0 through 9.4.5.3, and 10.0.0.1 through 10.0.0.5 contain a vulnerability where improper validation of message header structure length fields could allow an authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive information or cause a denial of service.
